meta.source: Solana mainnet public RPC (api.mainnet-beta.solana.com), read 2026-10-06 at confirmed: a PumpSwap migration by the migration authority and the completing buy on its bonding curve, as base64 getTransaction results.
meta.note: The migration transaction carries CreatePoolEvent, InitBoostEvent, CompletePumpAmmMigrationEvent and BuyEvent and no CompleteEvent; the CompleteEvent is in the completing buy, a separate transaction (the newest signature on the curve before the migration).
